content: 1. The current version of the applicable standard for fittings, as of the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition, is NSF/ANSI Standard 14-2008e. 2. The product is currently under development at the Task Group level for inclusion in NSF/ANSI Standard 50. 3. For pipes, the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition is NSF/ANSI Standard 14-2008e. 4. Pumps are governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, UL 1081 (non-metallic pumps up to 5 hp), California Assembly Bill 1953, and the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008) as the current standards. 5. Strainers are subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 6. Gauges are listed by NSF to meet an engineering specification as of the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 7. Flow meters are also listed by NSF to meet an engineering specification as of the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 8. HVAC and dehumidifiers are governed by UL 1995 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 9. Solar pool heaters are subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 10. Furnaces are governed by ANSI Z83.8-2006 for gas heaters and gas-fired duct furnaces, CSA 2.6-2006 for gas heaters and gas-fired duct furnaces, and UL 757 for oil-fired furnaces as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 11. Boilers are subject to the ASME Boiler Code, ANSI Z21.13, and CSA 4.9 for gas-fired hot water boilers as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 12. Gas-fired pool heaters are governed by ANSI Z21.10.3, CSA 4.3, and ANSI Z21.56/CSA 4.7 as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 13. Flues are subject to UL 1777 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 14. Rapid sand filters, high-rate sand filters, and precoat filters are governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 15. Filters previously known as diatomaceous earth filters are now referred to as precoat filters due to the significant use of alternative filter media such as perlite. 16. Filter media are subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 17. Cartridge filters are governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 18. Other filter types are also subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 19. Mechanical chemical feeding equipment is governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, UL 1081, and CSA C22 as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 20. Ozone generators are subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, UL 1081, CSA C22, and the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008) as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 21. Ultraviolet light systems are governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, which includes testing for Cryptosporidium validation, CSA C22, and the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008) as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 22. In-line electrolytic chlorinators are subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, UL 1081, CSA C22, the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008), and Canadian PMRA as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 23. Brine batch electrolytic chlorine or bromine generators are governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, UL 1081, CSA C22, the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008), and Canadian PMRA as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 24. Copper/silver and copper ion generators are subject to NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013, UL 1081, CSA C22, the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008), and Canadian PMRA as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 25. Chemical storage is governed by the United States National Fire Code NFPA-1 (2009) as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 26. Automated controllers are subject to the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008) as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 27. Water quality testing devices are governed by NSF/ANSI Standard 50-2013 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 28. General electrical equipment is subject to the United States National Electrical Code NFPA-70 (2008) as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 29. Lights are governed by UL 1241 (junction boxes for swimming pool luminaires), UL 676 (underwater luminaires and submersible junction boxes), UL 8750 (LED equipment for use in lighting products), and UL 379 (transformers for fountain, swimming pool, and spa luminaires) as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 30. Diving boards and platforms are subject to ANSI/NSPI-1 2003 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 31. Starting blocks are governed by ANSI/NSPI-1 2003, FINA, NFSHSA, and NCAA as the applicable standards at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 32. Lifeguard chairs are subject to ANSI/NSPI-1 2003 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 33. Ladders are governed by ANSI/NSPI-1 2003 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition. 34. Handrails are subject to ANSI/NSPI-1 2003 as the applicable standard at the release date of the MAHC 1st Edition.
